author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh lavash, glowing coals, and the timeless art of village baking 🌾🔥 In this video, we bake rustic lavash bread over glowing coals using a traditional method that has been passed down through generations.

The thin dough bakes quickly over the heat, developing beautiful golden spots while staying soft, flexible, and full of fresh homemade flavor. The gentle smokiness from the coals gives each piece of lavash an authentic taste that only open-fire baking can create.

This is true village baking at its finest — simple ingredients, glowing coals, and generations of tradition. A classic flatbread that perfectly captures the warmth, simplicity, and authentic flavor of countryside cooking. 🍞🌿🔥
title: Bread Baking: Rustic Flatbread Cooked Over Glowing Coals 🌾🔥
